people.name: Ai
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua after initial defeat.

people.name: Beth-aven
people.line: Town and wilderness near Ai and Bethel.

people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth Aven, on the east side of Bethel, and spoke to them, saying, “Go up and spy out the land.” The men went up and spied out Ai.
translations.bsb: Meanwhile, Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is near Beth-aven to the east of Bethel, and told them, “Go up and spy out the land.” So the men went up and spied out Ai.
translations.kjv: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Bethaven, on the east side of Bethel, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and view the country. And the men went up and viewed Ai.
translations.asv: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth-aven, on the east side of Beth-el, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and spy out the land. And the men went up and spied out Ai.
